name: CareTeamAlert
title: Care Team Alert
description: An exception escalation to a care team member. Created by the miraEscalation automation when a session shows sustained disruption (valence spike, repeated resolving posture, or explicit distress signal). Each alert carries the operational context (not PHI) and a delivery status for the Slack/email connector. Care team members authenticate via Base44 auth (Google login) and see alerts scoped to them.

severity.description: watch = monitoring; follow_up = Mira will follow up; escalate = care team should reach out.

reason.description: Operational reason for the alert. Not PHI; derived from posture and valence, not chat content.

delivery_status.description: Status of the Slack/email delivery. Care team acknowledges through the dashboard.

delivery_channel.description: Where the alert was sent. Slack connector when configured; dashboard_only as fallback.

acknowledged_by.description: Email of the care team member who acknowledged this alert. Null until acknowledged.
